opening: Myth or fact? If we only receive invoices, we don't need an ASP.
source: MoF announcement of Ministerial Decisions 243 and 244 of 2025 (29 Sep 2025); checked 12 Nov 2026
instagram:
Myth or fact? If we only receive invoices, we don't need an ASP.

Myth, for in-scope businesses. The UAE Ministry of Finance says both the issuer and the recipient fulfil their e-invoicing obligations through the Accredited Service Provider they have appointed (MoF, 29 Sep 2025; checked 12 Nov 2026).

List suppliers who will send e-invoices
Check your ERP can take them in
